location.address: 45/1F, OMR Road, Thiruporur Post, Illalur Village, Chengalpattu, Tamil Nadu - 603110

contact.corporate_office: Wonderla Holidays Ltd Corporate Office, 9th Floor, The Estate, Dickenson Road, Bengaluru 560042

operating_hours.notes: Park opens 365 days a year. Certain outdoor rides may temporarily halt during extreme lightning or monsoon downpours.

ticket_pricing.gst_policy: Prices subject to 18% GST or inclusive where stated

fastrack_pass.description: Skip regular queues and enjoy dedicated express entry for all major thrill rides. Limited quantities per day.
fastrack_pass.pricing_addon: Base ticket rate + 100% surcharge (~₹1,312 to ₹1,549 additional)

discounts_and_promotions.name: College Student Pass
discounts_and_promotions.eligibility: Valid student college photo ID card required at entry. One ticket per ID.

discounts_and_promotions.name: Hall Ticket Offer
discounts_and_promotions.eligibility: For students who appeared in 10th, 12th board or competitive exams with hall ticket.

discounts_and_promotions.name: Buy 3 Get 1 Free (Funtastic 4)
discounts_and_promotions.discount: Pay for 3 adult tickets, get 4th ticket completely free
discounts_and_promotions.eligibility: Available for online advance bookings on select weekdays.

discounts_and_promotions.name: Wonder Women Wednesday
discounts_and_promotions.discount: Buy 2 Get 2 Free for all-women groups
discounts_and_promotions.eligibility: Applicable on Wednesdays. All visitors in the booking must be female.

discounts_and_promotions.name: Birthday BOGO Offer
discounts_and_promotions.discount: Buy 1 Get 1 Free for birthday person
discounts_and_promotions.eligibility: Must visit during the birthday month; requires government DOB ID proof.

discounts_and_promotions.name: Early Bird & Monsoon Flash Sale
discounts_and_promotions.discount: Up to 35% discount for online bookings 7+ days in advance

height_categories.infant: Height below 85 cm enter absolutely FREE

dress_code_policy.water_rides: 100% Synthetic, Lycra, Polyester, or Nylon swimwear is strictly mandatory. Cotton shirts, jeans, sarees, dupattas, and garments with metal zippers/rivets are strictly banned on water slides.
dress_code_policy.costume_purchases: Synthetic swimwear, burkinis, shorts, and tees are sold on-site starting from ₹350.
dress_code_policy.dry_rides: Comfortable footwear and casual attire. Secure loose items before boarding inversion rides.

amenities_and_facilities.lockers: RFID EZ-Pay wristband lockers available for rent (~₹100-₹150 + ₹100 refundable security deposit). Cashless digital wallet inside park.
amenities_and_facilities.food_policy: Outside food and beverages are strictly prohibited (infant food permitted).
amenities_and_facilities.first_aid: Fully staffed medical emergency response center with ambulance on standby.
amenities_and_facilities.parking: Dedicated multi-level parking for 2-wheelers and 4-wheelers. Valet and EV charging supported.
amenities_and_facilities.accessibility: Wheelchair ramps, dedicated wheelchair rentals, and baby feeding care rooms available.

dining_venues.name: Poriyal Restaurant
dining_venues.cuisine: Authentic Tamil Nadu delicacies, South Indian Thali, Idli, Dosa

dining_venues.name: Food Court
dining_venues.cuisine: Multi-cuisine quick service counters: North Indian, Chinese, Chaat, Pizzas

dining_venues.name: Galaxy Restaurant
dining_venues.cuisine: Multi-cuisine family dining with AC indoor hall

dining_venues.name: Park View Restaurant
dining_venues.cuisine: Buffet and combo meals with scenic views of park attractions

dining_venues.name: Biryani Zone
dining_venues.cuisine: Authentic Ambur and Hyderabadi Dum Biryani with kebabs

dining_venues.name: Waves Restaurant
dining_venues.cuisine: Snacks, fresh juices, and ice creams located adjacent to the Wave Pool

dining_venues.name: Aqua Cafe
dining_venues.cuisine: Burgers, french fries, cold sodas, and mocktails

attractions_and_rides.name: Tanjora
attractions_and_rides.description: India's first-ever B&M Inverted Roller Coaster. Swiss engineered floorless suspended design featuring zero-G rolls, high-speed wing-overs, and maximum G-forces.

attractions_and_rides.name: Recoil
attractions_and_rides.description: India's first action-packed reverse looping roller coaster. Climbs 40 meters, plunges through loops, and retraces the entire layout backwards.

attractions_and_rides.name: Equinox 360
attractions_and_rides.description: A gravity-defying pendulum thrill monster that swings riders upside down in a complete 360-degree axial rotation.

attractions_and_rides.name: Flash Tower
attractions_and_rides.description: Vertical drop tower blasting riders upward and dropping them into sudden zero-gravity freefall.

attractions_and_rides.name: Termite Coaster
attractions_and_rides.description: Ride on the edge with sharp hairpin curves, steep climbs, and dizzying drops through wooded scenery.

attractions_and_rides.name: Drop Loop
attractions_and_rides.description: Trapdoor sky-high slope dropping riders almost vertically into a high-speed inclined water loop.

attractions_and_rides.name: Wonder Splash
attractions_and_rides.description: Bogie boat ascending a steep rail track before hurtling down a 28-meter slope into a monumental tidal splash.

attractions_and_rides.name: Korneto
attractions_and_rides.description: Whirling tornado funnel slide where multi-person rafts swing up 45-degree walls before flushing into the pool.

attractions_and_rides.name: Wave Pool
attractions_and_rides.description: Expansive artificial beachfront with computer-generated oceanic surf waves, shallow shoreline, and deep waters.

attractions_and_rides.name: Rain Disco
attractions_and_rides.description: Indoor dance floor equipped with intelligent psychedelic laser lighting, pounding acoustic bass, and warm rain showers.

attractions_and_rides.name: Mission Interstellar
attractions_and_rides.description: Hyper-realistic space flight simulation with 4K laser projection, synchronized 6-DOF motion hydraulic seats, and atmospheric wind effects.

attractions_and_rides.name: Boomerang
attractions_and_rides.description: Raft drops down an enclosed tube before rocketing up a near-vertical curved wall, pausing at the peak, and sliding backwards.
